dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why don't we talk about Pers?

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: ...Ah, thank you for remembering its name.

choices.text: Is there a story behind Pers's name?

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: To explain it... I'll need to tell you a really, really old story I once read in a picture book.

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: Mhm... So once upon a time, in a faraway seaside town, there lived a black and white bird.

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: Since birth, it spoke with a stutter, walked with a wobble, and was unable to fly, so it was always bullied by the other birds.

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: Until one day, greedy pirates stole a jewel-studded diadem from the underwater palace...

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: In a flash, lightning and thunder engulfed the sea, and a tsunami rose from the depths, threatening to wipe out the entire town...

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: The black-and-white bird tried to leap upwards, but it still couldn't fly... In its recklessness, it crashed against the mast and sank into the ocean alongside the wrecked ship.

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: The seabirds flying overhead thought it would drown right then and there, but to their surprise, it began to swim like the swiftest of fish!

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: It swam and swam, until its strength finally gave out. It restored the diadem to its rightful place underwater, and immediately, the storms died down, and it was as if nothing bad had ever happened.

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: As you've probably guessed by now... The bird in the story was named Pers. It was a penguin that came to town by accident.

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: I've always admired the Pers in the story, but after reading it, what struck me the most was... its loneliness.

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: So, I decided to stick close and hug Pers, so we can keep each other warm...

choices.text: Ah, I didn't know you were friends with a hero!
Why does Pers look the way it does?
